items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Yes, Tommy Ladnier was with him. I replaced a trumpet player named Edwards... I replaced Edwards and Jerry Blake replaced...

ctx.x: Yes, Tommy Ladnier was with him. I replaced a trumpet player named Edwards. I don't remember his first name. He had a brother who was a bass player with Sam Wooding. And I replaced Edwards and Jerry Blake replaced -- well I don't think he replaced anyone, I don't know whether he replaced or what not, but they took Jerry Blake and a drummer, new drummer there and a trombone player was replaced which Herbert Flemming Fleming.
I see. And what was that band like?
